**Reproduced, and the proposed fix verified.**

**Environment:** macOS (Darwin 25.2.0), Node.js v26.0.0, `react@19.2.8`, `react-dom@19.2.8`, `jsdom@29.1.1`

The crash reproduces deterministically with a minimal script — concurrent render via `createRoot`, then deleting `global.window` / `global.document` before the deferred Scheduler task fires:

```
ReferenceError: window is not defined
    at performWorkOnRootViaSchedulerTask (react-dom-client.development.js)
    at Immediate.performWorkUntilDeadline (scheduler.development.js)
```

I also verified the fix empirically: applying the guard

```js
typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.event : undefined
```

to the three unguarded reads (`trackSchedulerEvent`, `resolveEventType`, `resolveEventTimeStamp`) in the development bundle makes the exact same repro exit cleanly, with the scheduled task completing safely.

This matches the change proposed in #37102. I also ran the identical script against `react@19.1.1` / `react-dom@19.1.1` and can confirm it does not crash there, consistent with this being a 19.2.0 regression.
